title: Unit – 1 : Session – 3 : SLO – 1  |  Evolution of OS — Batch Systems Crossword
sections: 1. PUNCHED CARDS — input devices used in the first generation to submit jobs.
3. BATCH (SERIAL) PROCESSING — processing model where one job was done at a time.
4. JCL (JOB CONTROL LANGUAGE) — language used to describe jobs to the monitor in second-generation systems.
6. FORTRAN — programming language commonly used for batch programs (also COBOL).
7. BATCHING — organizing multiple jobs together for execution in sequence.
8. KERNEL MODE (PRIVILEGED MODE) — special OS mode used to execute system-level instructions.
9. MONITOR — device used for showing, watching, or listening to something.
The letters in the bold rectangles spell the hidden word: BATCH (the theme of the worksheet is
batch processing in early operating systems).
